R903.note: Verified by running the exact fixed concatenation in Python/markupsafe: mixing a plain str with escape()'s Markup result promotes the whole running 'page' string to Markup, so the next += auto-escapes the already-built literal HTML tags too - every response renders as literal '<html><body>...' text instead of an actual page. Script injection is inert but the fix silently breaks all legitimate output, undisclosed.
